title: A stable influence summand bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $\\rho\\ge0$. For any subset $S$ of the coordinates containing $i$, the summand $\\rho^{|S|-1}$ times the square of the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ on $S$ is at most the stable influence of $f$ at parameter $\\rho$ and coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$S$ is a finite subset of the coordinates
